reviews.text: This facility and its staff are some of the most compassionate people I have met, especially when it comes to our fur babies. They understand the needs of ALL and treat everyone and their babies like they are their own loved ones! Please if anyone needs ANY type of care, urgent or non-urgent for their four legged family members, come and see the wonderful people at CHEW. They were a blessing to my baby! Thank you to all of you guys involved in caring for our fur baby ❤️

The people at Chew, from Charlene at the front desk to the vet assistants to the Doctors, are all very kind, very understanding, very competent and very hard working. If there are any issues, they listen attentively then do whatever they can to resolve the issue as expeditiously and comprehensively as possible. Their pricing is more than reasonable and lower than other “low cost” pet services. Despite the fact that they are a non-profit organization, they have a 2 tier “Compassion Fund” available for low income clients. And it really is “available”, not just a bullet point on their site to make them look good. I know, because within 24 hours, I submitted the application, was approved and the bill was paid. Finally, I’ve found a veterinary clinic that I can live with and more importantly, so can my dogs!

I took my kitty to Chew Animal Clinic for the first time and had a wonderful experience. Melissa was very thorough in describing the plan of action for ‘Poodle’ and passionate about the clinic’s mission as a non profit. Dr Deason is extremely informative, and seems very conscientious and passionate about her profession. She quickly built confidence in her ability to find a solution. Poodle and I are grateful to have found this place🫶.

The best vet option I have ever known, I came recommended by a friend whose dog was very sick and the vets they took him to said the only option was to put him to sleep, and here they managed to operate on him, since it was a very delicate hernia surgery, and they saved him. After experiencing this case so closely with my friend, I knew this was the option to take my cat to, previously I took him to a vet who only charged me and never actually checked my cat. I was fed up with the situation and worried about my cat's health, since he is not a cat that lets himself be easily examined. The price options they offered me here were also very good, you can tell the doctors work out of vocation and this is the kind of doctor we need. They inspire a lot of trust and convey a lot of confidence. The doctors really answer all the questions you have, they are very attentive, they also make sure to ask you everything about your pet. Everyone who works there is super friendly.

Now I recommend this veterinary clinic to everyone I know who has pets.

I just got a call response! They make an appointment tomorrow for my dog I will pray to God to save my dog tomorrow. Thank you!!
Chew was very kind and helpful they help my dog and save him 🙏 ❤️ God bless their heart! They truly help animals and that is so amazing 👏
Also provided me compassion fund information. A real blessing!!!! I was all around looking for help and no one did what they did!!! Thank you!!!!
I am truly grateful that my sweet baby dog will receive help with a help fund that will save my dog!!! Thank CHEW for your help!!!
This organization really saves lives . I’m so grateful for their help with my fur Baby Cody🙌 .  So glad to be able to get assistance. Customer service is amazing. Thanks Mrs. Lee  ❤️

The people here are so amazing and wonderful and caring I sat there through my whole appointment with my fur baby and just cried and they comfort me which they did not have to do and breaks my heart I wish I could do more but the people at the clinic have been wonderful and I'm doing everything in their power to help me and help my baby his name is baby because he's a Pomeranian and he's my big old baby. All the staff was wonderful and friendly and the place was clean did not stink did not smell like dogs and they had the most friendliest kitty cat greeting everyone. I took my baby in because he has a lump in one of his lymph nodes they're doing everything they can to help him feel comfortable and also helping me to stay calm so I can help baby I wish there was a way to post a picture of my sweet boy

I took my Rocky into the office for what we thought was going to be surgery on his broken femur. Come to find out he actually had osteosarcoma and we chose to put him to sleep. The ladies stood on the phone with me for hours explaining his outcome and giving us our options and supporting our decision to humanely end his life. Very compashionate staff.

CHEW Animal Clinic and Dr. Mountain have shown extraordinary care and expertise throughout my dog Justice’s TPLO journey. From the moment we walked in, the entire team treated Justice with genuine compassion and patience, making a stressful situation feel manageable and supported.

Dr. Mountain’s surgical skill, clear communication, and calm confidence gave me complete trust in Justice’s procedure. Even though his recovery is still ongoing, I can already see how carefully and thoughtfully his care plan was crafted. Every step has been explained thoroughly, and I’ve always felt that Justice was in the hands of someone truly dedicated to his wellbeing.

I also want to express my heartfelt gratitude for the help we received through the Compassion Fund. Their support made an overwhelming time so much easier, and it reflects the clinic’s commitment not just to the animals they treat, but to the families who love them.

CHEW Animal Clinic and Dr. Mountain embody the perfect combination of skill, kindness, and true compassion. I’m deeply grateful for the care Justice has received and for the support that helped us through this process.

Chew Animal Clinic  has the best staff ever.  I brought my dog in today because an ER doctor referred me, after my dog was hospitalized for two days,  and my dog required more services that were too expensive.   I had taken my dog to an animal Hospital,  Clinic, and ER, but no one could figure out the root problem.   My dog came to Chew straight from the ER and after one ultrasound, my dog went in emergency surgery.   I had several other procedures & x-ray done at other facilities with no finding.  Chew did the ultrasound but the ultrasound did not tell much at all. The surgery doctor came out and said just because we don't see anything do not mean there is not a blockage.  My dogs is now in surgery.  They didn't just stop helping at surgery. Because the surgery is so expensive, they are now helping to raise funds to pay for it.  If you would like to donate to help save animals, please donate to Chew Animal Clinic in Dallas, TX.  Chew and their staff are truly GOD sent and they desire their praises.  I prayed to GOD  to line the right people up to help save my dog and all I have to say now, To GOD Be the Glory 🥰
I genuinely thought it was the end for my best friend but the compassion fund has given me hope for the future thank you so much!!
I can not thank the staff enough for the help and compassion shown to our Maggie.   You all have been a godsend.   Thank you all again.

Chew did an amazing job taking care of my cat! I reached out to them after my cat suffered a complete fracture to her arm, and I was so worried about what would happen next. Leigh was absolutely wonderful throughout the entire process. She took the time to explain the surgery, what they planned to do, and what I could expect during my cat’s recovery. The communication and care we received really helped ease my mind during such a stressful situation.

My cat is now back to her normal, playful self scratching up everything! 😂🐱 I’m so grateful for the care and compassion Chew showed her. Thank you, Chew and Leigh, for taking such great care of my baby! ❤️
They are so helpful and everyone is lovely.

After visiting three other veterinarians who were unable to help Bella, I was referred to CHEW Animal Clinic, and it truly changed her life. Dr. Mountain was the only veterinarian willing to take on the challenge of removing Bella’s ear with the goal of giving her the best quality of life possible. Instead of viewing her case as hopeless, he focused on giving Bella a second chance—and for that, I will be forever grateful.

Charlene at the front desk was incredibly compassionate and supportive. She talked me through seeing Bella for the first time after surgery, which meant more to me than I can put into words. Every veterinary technician I interacted with took the time to educate me before surgery, answer all of my questions, and make sure I felt confident that I was making the best decision for Bella.

What sets CHEW Animal Clinic apart is their genuine compassion. Every member of the team truly cared about Bella’s health, comfort, and happiness. They were always available, responsive, and supportive throughout her recovery.

Seven months later, Bella is doing absolutely amazing. Watching her happy, comfortable, and enjoying life again is the greatest gift I could have asked for, and I owe so much of that to Dr. Mountain, Charlene, and the incredible veterinary team at CHEW Animal Clinic.

If you’re looking for the most knowledgeable, compassionate, and caring veterinary team, look no further. Thank you all for giving Bella a second chance at life. I will never forget everything you’ve done for Bella and for me.

I wanted to express my deepest gratitude to the chew clinic & compassion fund. The director of Chew is AMAZING.. This place right here puts the hope & compassion back into the world. Staff, director, surgeon, amazing even the AI on the phone was cool.. lol..THANK YOU TO THE MOON 🌙 for saving my service dog Romeo Eugene💚

Our elderly friend has a little dog named max. Max became very sick very quickly and we were referred to CHEW. All I can say is what a Godsend they were! The doctors and staff where amazing! When money for his treatment became an issue they guided us step by step to getting the care max needed. Thank goodness Max is doing so much better
Dr. Deason and her staff are wonderful and caring.  I highly recommend CHEW.

words can’t even fathom to the care they provided for my cat(missa) she is up and running again watching me cook in the kitchen i am overly grateful for them getting me in asap and caring for her im soo thankful! i recommend this practice to anyone in need!

This place is god sent...can't say enough great things about this clinic..they treated my dog so well since the time I dropped him off till pickup time...They were there for my baby when he needed them...I will always have the upmost respect for every single staff member there...thank you CHEW🙏🏼From Zeus and his family ♥️🫶
I found a little kitten named tiger and he had worms they were so kind and helped me with him!

first off I love Dr Deason she is amazing kind and you can tell she cares about your babies just as much as you do!  also everybody I've talked to from Charlene to Melissa have all been fabulous caring and calming... and the best thing is their prices are reasonable compared to other veterinarians... my Mozart was  sick I hadn't worked since February due to two total hip replacements and things in between that I did not count on that happened after surgery... they were able to help me through their fund and he got taken care of and got diagnostics that he needed...Leigh was also kind !

The service chew provides is honestly incredible - the only complaint I could possibly make is that they can be difficult to reach outside normal hours, but their doctors really care about their animals and they provide high quality service for a better price than almost anywhere else, and that's even without their Compassion fund, which helps those in need even more. My dog had to get a major surgery done here, and  chew was nearly half the cost of other locations while still being high quality. They are honestly life savers for pet owners, especially those in need.

Hi Rachel - is there a reason why you are leaving a 1 star review? We don't see any communication in our system and would really like to know how to resolve any concerns. Please email us at feedback@CHEWac.org , we would really like to have feedback, so we can understand why and make any changes necessary.

I cant even express the gratitude for chew animal clinic, I was told by another clinic that euthanasia would be the best thing so that's what I called chew for. So they were all pleasant, helpful and told me they could operate her and also sponsor some of the cost. Thanks to chew clinic my companion is still here they are a blessing to all animals
Amazing staff!!! Very caring and the only clinic like this is the North Texas area. Highly recommended!
Tried to get my pet in to see someone and couldn't  get in because they weren't  accepting  new clients

They are amazing, caring , fast , I feel heard and taking care . Bill was nothing crazy and my cat was very calm when I pick him up . .Everyone was attentive and friendly.

Thank you so much Chew Animal Clinic
Love
Nora Molina

I brought my dog in last week to get neutered and I couldn't be happier with the experience. The whole staff was friendly, caring, and made sure he was treated so well. Thank you for taking such great care of him!

Chew saved my dog’s life! My dog had a perineal hernia, and when I reached out to Chew, they acted fast and were a pleasure to work with. Their prices are also very fair. The owner, Leigh, was an absolute gem from booking the surgery all the way through recovery. I would recommend Chew to any animal lover. 💛

I bought in my dog Starr for surgery.I staff was so friendly and very professional.I”ll experience at Chew Animal Clinic was the best I have encounter since taking Starr for any treatments she have prevented in her 10 year life span.I have chosen to make Chew Animal Clinic our permanent pet care clinic.She is doing great from her surgery and it all thanks to the amazing doctors,nurses and staff.I would recommend anyone I know too visit them with full confidence in their pet care and whatever treatment.Thanks too Chew Animal Clinic and the amazing staff.

Chew AC truly came to the rescue for us. My 7-year-old dog tore his TPLO, and they were able to get him in for an exam within just a few days. The team made sure he was comfortable, safe, and well cared for from the moment we arrived.

They quickly scheduled his surgery and sent me home with more information and guidance than I could have imagined, which helped me feel prepared and confident for the procedure.

Another thing that really stood out was their affordable pricing, which makes necessary treatment accessible for pet owners who might otherwise struggle to afford it.

I highly recommend Chew AC. The staff, both in the front and behind the scenes, are incredibly compassionate, friendly, and truly make you feel like part of the family.
Im so glad i found this clinic i was really worried for my puppy i did not think i would find an affordable clinic but i did and im glad for it now i just hope my puppy heals well

CHEW has been nothing but amazing! We were worried about our little puppy going in for surgery but Lee and Charlene have made it amazing ! I call and ask questions and not once have they made me feel like I was over doing it! I’ve gotten updates, I know our little Bella is in amazing hands!
We were able to adopt an amazing puppy from Chew. They were so easy to work with once the puppy arrived and really set us up with everything we needed to welcome our new addition to their new home.

Nothing but positive things to say about our adoption process through Chew! They have messaged us to check on the puppy as well as answered any question we have had! We will be back in about a month to receive boosters and to get the puppy fixed. I just know that Chew will make that process seamless as well!
I adopted an Aussiedoodle from Chew and it was a great experience! Chew does great work and I highly recommend donating to their Compassion Fund.
They are very  kind, knowledgeable,  sweet! They helped us when we needed it the most with my baby. Will have definitely  found our home vet ! Thank you CHEW!

Chew animal clinic has been a true gift to our pets.  No one is better than Dr. Deason.  Not only is she incredible with her diagnosis and care for our dogs, but she still takes the time to come out and visit with us and answers any questions we have.

Dr. Deason recently found a tumor on one of out dogs.  Thankfully she caught it early and we were able to schedule the surgery within two weeks.  The surgery went well and I'm grateful we will have more years with "Cali" because of the wonderful care we received at Chew.

The rest of the staff is just as responsive. Thanks to to Chew!  I can't wait to see the new clinic.  You guys deserve the best!

Le & the rest of the team a Chew totally made me feel at ease in suck a stressful time. My cat Sailor broke her leg & really needed care. Thank you so much for the compassion fund, helped Sailor’s medical cost taken care of. I can’t express how grateful I am for Chew & the care the provided for my baby. Thank you so much!
Great Organization. Highly recommend. Helped me get the live saving surgery my dog needed!  Thank you for saving my best friend!!

Terrible place

First of all, the staff never answers the phone which is very frustrating.

As soon as you arrive you can tell it’s a very disorganized and unprofessional place. 5 people including me were in line waiting an hour before the doors opened, 5 mins before opening the clinic a lady arrives and tells the front desk lady she is number 1 in line. We told the staff but they couldn’t care less, they just said “There’s nothing we can do” and proceeded to check the lady in.

The male tech has a very poor attitude, he seems so lost. He gave me the most unreasonable care plan after I picked up my dog, I asked him to double check with the vet because anything he was recommending made sense, he went back and of course everything he had said wasn’t the real plan the vet was giving us.

A few people have told me this place can’t receive any bad reviews because the manager will come after you, stalk you and God knows what else but before investing so much time in fighting the people that leaves bad reviews go to your clinic, talk and train your staff, that’s were time should be invested.
Chew is PAWmazing! The staff is sooo wonderful, friendly, caring, and compassionate! Highly recommend !!!

I reached out to CHEW Animal Clinic since my baby Diamond need TPLO surgery. Shirlen (medical receptionist) was able to talk to the staff and get me an appointment so that Diamond could get an appointment. I'm dealing with financial hardship and applied for the Compassion Fund and they approved to help with part of the surgery cost. I"m so thankful so even get some assistance and they we're able to accommodate us through this situation.

Chew animal clinic has been the best and a huge blessing to my family not only are they getting him in quick for surgery but they also provided an affordable option and there compassion fund was even able to contribute during this hard time for my family. Chew animal clinic has given me hope in this traumatizing time we are experiencing and we are forever grateful.

Saved my pup’s life, literally. If it wasn’t for the Compassion Fund, I wouldn’t had been able to afford the surgery that my pup needed to survive. I will be bringing her here for all of her future needs. May God continue to bless their organization abundantly. My family will forever will be grateful.
Super nice.
Everything's great♡

Chew truly went above and beyond for our family. My 2-year-old Frenchie, Chapo, needed emergency obstruction surgery, and their team moved fast and handled everything with professionalism and heart.

They also helped me financially through their program, which made it possible for Chapo to get the life-saving care he needed. I’m incredibly thankful.

The director personally stayed in contact with me, even after hours and on weekends, checking on Chapo and answering questions. That kind of dedication shows how much they truly care.

Chapo is alive and thriving because of them. I can’t recommend Chew enough.
The workers were very sweet, and did all they can to help my cat get back into a more stable condition. Without their help I wouldn’t know where I would be right now.

*UPDATE: The genuine love I have for this place is astronomical! Leigh, is such an amazing person and what u and ur staff are doing everyday to help people and their pets is a little piece of heaven on earth!! Its not easy work to take in animals, cleaning up after them and giving them another chance at life. I know there are days when yall may think you're over it, and the day is long and chaotic, but just so u know yall are really out here changing lives for more people and pets than u probably realize♡  What yall did for my Lola, may have been a bit of a situation but y'all came through when I hoestly abt to give up hope and thougjt she wasnt going to have the opportunity yall gave her, and she is living her best life!  I'll never forget it.♡ *

Honestly I'd be so lost without Chew! ♡ everyone that answers the phone are saints, and make you feel welcome and at ease! Couldn't ask for a better animal clinic to help me through my pups leg surgery!  Great price, great people and all around great place to bring your pet!♡♡♡  Much love for this place and it's staff!
Nice experience

We thank God for the Chew crew👏. You saved our Pumpkin, and we’re grateful that we found you when we did. Every veterinary clinic that I contacted gave the same estimate of between seven and ten thousand dollars…..It’s been four days since Pumpkins Open  Pyometra  surgery and by day two she was pretty much back to normal. Thank you so much for everything.
Absolutely amazing. They did everything they could to help me get my baby girl Mimi the emergency surgery she needed.Chew clinic and staff are wonderful!!!!! God is good!!!!

My cat ate a sticker and got his intestines blocked right after I had my own surgery and was out of work. CHEW and the compassion fund saved my cat’s life when I wasn’t able to help him, and I couldn’t be more grateful for them.

The people who work here are ANGELS. Do you hear me? ANGELS. I had a last minute walk in because my poor kitten was sick and had blockage. They stayed late just to x ray him and tend to his needs. It honestly brings tears to my eyes, because I know the employees were tired, they’re hard working, but that didn’t stop them from caring for my precious kitten.
These people deserve all the love and admiration in the world.

Thank you so much to every single employee for all you do. Thank you for taking such good care of my Milo! ❤️
The staff at this place were so kind. I'm so grateful for their care and treatment of my little Nala. Thank you so much to the entire team. Happy Holidays! Blessings to each and every one of them.

I highly  recommend  this vet clinic .
I had the best experience  the staff  there is great so helpful  and caring  for all the fur babies  they helped  me so much with my little nova thank you

Hi.👋  I will be back with the review after I finish with BBB and code compliance about the dirty filthy conditions at this veterinarians business. They do exams and Consultation in the waiting room. Then you can't go back with your pet, because of Filthyness, they never requested X-rays until I asked for a refill I thought would help her while they were on vacation, then they requested X-rays, for refills I have all this information in texts and emails and recordings of the receptionist.
I never said I wanted x-rays when she was in their waiting room throwing up all over and couldn't breath, we didnt wait till after it was not 44 days Leigh, and now that I know you are not a veterinarian or even vet tech I know now why you never bring up the dog or cat or animal period you are awful dreadful person and anyone reading this needs to be aware I sat at home took off work with a dying dog calling everyday, most days more than two or three times a day to the receptionist who would huff and puff because she didn't even want to talk to us or anything because you all, were on vacation, and didn't answer to her either. after they gave her a 170.OO allergy shot not being able to talk to a single sole about what I should do, no one on call. Come on now face it she was treated wrongly. Point blank. I've not talked with you because like I said here I've went thru different channels and it took me a while to reach two of the people that were in the waiting room with their pets when we were. Have a nice day Leigh I wouldve talked with Dr. Deason so she could've shared some of my concerns and what we seen in the waiting room and what she had in her notes, but I see by now, because of you, none of what happened or the truth is left anywhere there now.

My fur baby had a recurrent UTI and we could not figure out what was going on or what was causing it. Found out about chew animal clinic and we took her in and they were very quick with an appointment and the service was excellent I really appreciate the staff. They were  able to come up with a care plan and get treatment started on her. Very happy with this clinic and will most definitely take my doggos here.

The first visit was good, then for the second appointment I was asked to drop off my pet at 8:00 am and pick him up around 4:30 pm, he needed to be fasted. I arrived to pick him up at 3:45 pm and I realized they haven’t even started with him.

When we checked in, I asked for a specific vaccine but when I was about to pay I noticed that they applied a different vaccine that I didn’t ask for because this same clinic applied it 2 weeks before. I was charged for a test that wasn’t done, also I asked for a recheck of a disease that my pet tested positive for (we needed to confirm the diagnosis so they needed to run a second test), which they also forgot to do. They basically didn’t even know what my pet was there, which I couldn’t understand since I gave all the information to the lady at the front desk. So at 3:45 pm I had to tell them what to do with her… the poor thing was there since 8 am and fasted for nothing!

I couldn’t talk to the vet on our second appointment, a technician was in charge of letting me know how the appointment went but tbh I don’t even think a vet saw her and we got a wrong dosis of 2 medications (Verified by two vets of the new clinic we are attending, who mentioned that those prescribed dosis wouldn’t do anything to her).

After 2 visits at this clinic we decided not to come back.

Most people have a fear of the unknown, but CHEW made this entire process feel so seamless! I brought Moe (The coolest cat) in due to him having some complications using the potty. They got him in and got the ball rolling! Within a few days he had his surgery and was on the road to recovery! They provided great post-op care as well. Moe has finally gotten his protective cone off and for the first time in a while he’s back to himself!! I’m thankful CHEW was there to help keep me and Moe’s bond going strong!

This company don’t answer the phone I’ve called for two weeks and left messages and still no response. I took my dog there to have a cyst removed. They charged me an office visit and only told me they can give her her shots. They will have to reschedule for the Sis removal, but I’ve been waiting for the quote and still have not received it. It’s going on three weeks now Won’t be going back.

I didn't know what I would've done if it weren't for Chew Animal Clinic. My baby. Venom, had a lump rapidly growing and they were able to get her in to start the process for surgical evaluation. Jenna was very clear with directions as to what my next steps were, and even gave me some avenues to try since it was a sudden expenditure.  The team here is fun, friendly, and super caring. Don't let looks fool you, these people are rockstars.

I was lucky enough to get 2 of my cats FREE vaccinations today thanks to a free vaccines event for Giving Day today!! I have been a client at CHEW for several years now & I can't say enough great things about the team they have there!!!!

I don't have enough words to say how amazing all the staff is, they really care and you can tell they love their job on top of being super knowledgeable, they saved our kitty's life (Mr. Cute) and we can't thank them enough. We went to two different clinics before finding them and we will come here from now on, we recommend them 100% to anyone for anything they're here to take care of your pets.
PLEASE DONATE TO THEIR FOUND they help families who don't have a lot of money to cover unexpected medical expenses
I also wanted to add after reading some negative reviews since one had the same problem as our cat (a blocked urethra) which is very serious and you have to take in consideration that a lot of people sadly took their pets too late to Chew and when other places don't want to help you they sent you to them, everybody there is super respectful, professional and they don't judge at all and I saw that they treat everybody equally so please support them

I have no words that best describe this place other than Top Notch. Took very gentle care of my pet as well as my GF and I through this stressful situation. Very down to earth and caring people. I will not be going anywhere else for any other problems, they have my business for life
These guys are the most caring vet team I have ever worked with. They are no nonsense & straight forward which I totally appreciate.
Cannot get a hold of them for records. They don't answer their phone they don't answer their email. Better not lose anything.

Back in October 2024 I took my Lulu for surgery and they treated her special. She needed a blood transfusion and they went all the way to save her. They made her life comfortable enough live until she passed away in January. I will forever me be grateful to them❤️ They are simply the best God Bless Chew Animal Clinic.
This is the best place!

Chew Animal Clinic offers exceptional care with compassion and professionalism. The staff is not only kind and knowledgeable but also genuinely dedicated to both pets and their owners. I particularly commend their Compassion Fund—a remarkable initiative that embodies their unwavering commitment to assisting animals in distress. I highly recommend their services!
Excellent service and great professionals

They have helped my family with my cat. They are so sweet and compassionate about animals. They care and explain everything step my step on what they will do and what needs to be done.  After my cat got sick they even followed up with me to see how he has been doing. Couldn't be more thankful!
Great service. Wonderful choice for furry family members.

Great communication, great care of our baby girl, got done earlier than promised with her spay appointment, They are nice and friendly as well.  Would recommend them to others looking for low cost and through care.

The tears I have.. Thank you so my Chew Animal hospital & compassion fund & friends .. they completely covered my dog cinnamon & I’m grateful.. it’s so hard right now living off one income & I barely can afford to take care of me after my husband passed.. Cinnamon is our baby and I can’t bare to see her hurting. I tried everything! Eventually this was my last try & it felt like an eternity because my dog was rapidly declining.. after what seemed like forever they approved me! They kept me informed the whole step of the way via email.. help me find extra help and all.. the tears of joy.. please don’t give up .. there is help & people understanding your situation .. God bless you all ..

Just wanted to say how incredibly thankful I am for this place. My dog Nella contracted pyometra and was literally dying. Took her to the ER vet and they quoted me $10K for the surgery which I don’t have. I found CHEW and they were incredibly helpful, friendly, and treated my dog with care and love. I am writing this review to warn other people from this place. You will lose your dog if you put their life in chews hands. At the end of march I noticed a big bump on my American Akita, Kate. I called Chews after several recommendations and got scheduled on 04/04. They got some blood work done that they said will take 2 days for results to come back. At that point I have mentioned that my dog isn’t eating very well. From that day I called Chews many times to get the results of the blood work since I watch my dog’s health declining right before my eyes. They either didn’t answer at all or gave me an excuse that the results are being delayed. I got the results finally on 04/11.
I got scheduled again 04/15 to go over the results and plan a proper care for Kate. The results came with. Cancer in her breast, UTI, and diabetes. I’ve been given antibiotics for the UTI, but since we discover diabetes they didn’t want to operate on her breast until the diabetes is getting better. Sounds lovely, no? but then we began a journey with Chews of ignoring and delays. I’ve been told to get Kate on Freestyle libre for her diabetes and It finally arrived, I tried to schedule an appointment with Chews to put it on her. I called and called day after day and they never answered. On the 21st Kate finished with her antibiotics and I called again to schedule an appointment BEGGING them to rush and to get Freestyle libre in because Kate isn’t eating, she’s throwing up blood and having diarrhea.
I called times and times again. There was no answer. They never picked up the phone. Meanwhile I am watching my dog’s health declining right in front of me and my hands are tied behind my back. They finally answered and said that they have an appointment but only for next week but since her health had declined so bad it’s better if I take her elsewhere. After all this time of me waiting, calling, getting ignored I have advised to go elsewhere. And so I did. The new vet said the at this state her survival chances are 50/50 and it’s better to let her go and give her rest. With a heavy heart and a shattered family at home waiting for her to come back, we had to put my beloved dog, my best friend and my protector down. On 05/02 Kate crossed the rainbow bridge. And I was left with a hole in my heart. And anger, towards Chews, who ignored us, pushed us to the back of the line numerous times, 2 appointments that have been cancelled, had no sense of urgency towards a dying dog. Towards an owner begging and crying for help, after SO MANY phone calls. They told us to go elsewhere! They wasted crucial time! We were let down…KATE WAS LET DOWN. I lost her because of lack of care. She could’ve been saved with the right care, maybe if they actually cared for her….but she was just a number. Just another dog. PLEASE BEWARE OF THIS PLACE! I will do everything In my power to have no other owner and no other dog go through this facility so their life can be saved!

I am homeless and living in my car with my Chihuahua. She's my emotional support.. she's my mental support.. she's the only thing that gives me the strength to keep going through this difficult time in my life.
My dog ( Fiona) got really sick. She was moving in and out of her cage constantly. She was panting really hard with her tongue hanging to the side and all the way out of the side of her mouth. Her skin has turned dark and she is shaking a lot. I didn't know what to do because we're homeless and I don't have money to take her to a veterinarian. I went to the SPCA on Lonestar drive because I thought they would help her even though I didn't have money. I explained what happened and the guy told me they couldn't help me. He gave me a paper and highlighted the Chew Animal Clinic and told me that they could help me because he said they work with ppl but he doesn't know how much they charge so I asked should I just go there? He said yes and explain to them what you told me. I rushed over there. I made it and I went in with my dog. The receptionist asked could she help me??? I explained what was going on with my dog and I explained that I was homeless and living in my car. She immediately started looking at me and my dog with a look of disgust. She then abruptly said, The vet is gone for the day and we take appointments only and you have to pay money. I started to cry and I told her that the SPCA referred me there and told me that they do help ppl in my situation and I need help for my dog. She hesitantly told me, well we do have a program where we take a few cases but you would need to pay something and you would have to fill out an application to see if you will be accepted first. I asked how much she said it all depends on how much is in the fund and what they had to do to my dog. I said ok I work as a day Laborer and it's not much but I will pay what I can if she can get help. She grabbed a pen and started writing the info for the website for the application. I told her that I told the guy at the SPCA that her skin is turning black on her stomach and he said it could be bleeding on the inside. I raised her up and I said do you think this looks like bleeding in her stomach?? She wouldn't even look up at us..she rudely replied, "I couldn't tell ya..I'm not a Vet. Never even looked up to see it. Then Another lady came from the back with a large dog and told her she didn't want to stay in her cage. They both laughed and my dog growled at the big dog and I told her no. I said it's okay. Then I smiled at the lady like saying sorry. She had a blank piercing stare at me that chilled me to my bones. The other lady handed me the piece of paper with the info about applying to try and get help for my dog. I picked up the paper and she said fill that out and then if it's picked someone will get in touch with you. She said and with it being the holidays and all we don't have any appointments until after December 11 . I said okay. I'll fill it out. I said thank you. She didn't say one word. I looked up and her and the other lady was just looking at me like I was trash. No response to my thank you..Hope everything is okay.. No take care.. Nothing.
I left there and got my dog wrapped back up in her blanket and I cried and prayed to God to help us.
I have never been made to feel so disgusting and insignificant at the same time. I felt just the way they meant for me to feel... like trash.
No matter what someone's going through or financial situation...No one deserves to be treated like that.
It's wrong and it's mean and I couldn't live with myself if I treated ppl that way.
The people there are wonderful.   Very caring.

Brought my cat here Meow after I was told to come from another clinic. After they said they will do a surgery and help get his bladder unblocked (they found a mass in his bladder). In the next two days his prognosis went down from the initial plan that he would have surgery Friday because his kidney levels were very high. I went today to pick him up and take him home so the family could be with him before his last moments . Dr.Mountain insisted that he take a nausea medication that was not administered to him at all during his entire stay there. 15 minutes into the car ride home the cat who looked up at my mom while we were in the clinic took three deep breaths and passed away in my car.  My experience was not so great and is my opinion and review of this clinic.
